request.deadline: Rare Dev Gov Day on July 28, 2026 and Rare Evo 2026 on July 28-31, 2026 in Las Vegas
deliverables: Cardano title sponsorship for Rare Evo 2026 main stage and livestream
Cardano title sponsorship for Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026
free General Admission access for the Cardano community
complimentary booth space for selected Cardano ecosystem projects
travel and lodging support for 20 Cardano ecosystem contributors or volunteers
five Cardano-focused main stage panel opportunities
livestream ads and global livestream participation
tier-1 media coverage using 2-3 selected vendors
return of 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to make Cardano the title sponsor of Rare Evo 2026 main stage and global livestream and to support Rare Dev Gov Day 2026.

claims.claim: Rare Network requests ₳2,750,000, described as $660,000 at a $0.24 ADA valuation, to fund two Cardano sponsorship packages for Rare Evo 2026 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026.

The cost breakdown allocates ₳1,166,666.67 to Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026 sponsorship, ₳833,333.33 to Rare Evo 2026 title sponsorship, and ₳750,000 to Intersect, audit, fees, tax withholdings, and a Dev Gov Day 2027 venue deposit.
Rare Network says it will return 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury, with the current retail value of a VIP ticket stated as $900.

Rare Evo 2026 will occur regardless of treasury funding, but the proposal says treasury funding would expand Cardano presence, accessibility, participation, and strategic industry outreach through existing event infrastructure.

The proposal states Rare Evo 2025 had 2,500 attendees, 80 exhibitor booths, 85 speakers, 100+ ecosystem partners, 20K+ livestream views, 4M social impressions, 40+ Cardano projects represented, and 50+ enterprise participants.

The proposal states Cardano Dev Gov Day 2025 was free and publicly accessible, welcomed approximately 500 attendees, and included a Charles Hoskinson keynote, governance discussions, technical education, workshops, and community activities.
The document links to YouTube videos, a Google document report, and an X post as supporting material for Rare Evo 2025 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2025.

Rare Network claims it has been active in the Cardano ecosystem since 2020 and has produced more than 60 blockchain industry side events and activations across conferences including ETHDenver, TOKEN2049, Consensus, Duke Blockchain Conference, Paris Blockchain Week, and Cardano Summit.

The proposal says selected projects and contributors will use open application and qualification processes for speaking opportunities, booth space, volunteer participation, and travel or lodging assistance, prioritizing meaningful ecosystem contribution and in-person participation.

The sponsorship allocation may change if a different sponsor purchases the mainstage or livestream package before passage, in which case Cardano would receive a sponsorship of equal impact or dollar value such as Enterprise & Policy Social, Registration, Closeout Party, or College Row.

summary: The document requests ₳2.75 million for event sponsorships and related costs, presents historical event metrics and external references, but leaves important budget, feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, and community-impact analysis incomplete according to the deterministic assessment.
